story_type: fishing boat plowing through whitecaps far offshore, flight mechanic guides the basket onto the moving deck (hoist cam)
hook: Whitecaps, 80 miles offshore, and a fisherman who needed help.
narration: Eighty miles out in the Gulf of Mexico, this fishing boat was punching through whitecaps.
A thirty seven year old fisherman aboard needed a hospital.
So a Coast Guard helicopter came to him. The flight mechanic leaned out and steered the basket down.
Boats usually keep moving slowly into the wind during a hoist. It steadies them.
Then the cable came back up, with the fisherman in the basket.
outcome: The fisherman was taken to Tampa General Hospital in stable condition.
title: Hoisted off a fishing boat in whitecaps
description:
On Feb. 3, 2022, the Coast Guard medevaced a 37-year-old man from a commercial fishing vessel about 80 miles west of Tampa, Florida. He was taken to Tampa General Hospital in stable condition.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of U.S. Coast Guard Southeast, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/830161/coast-guard-medevacs-fisherman-80-miles-west-tampa
